note: Audio folders that are also served from the two media repositories on GitHub Pages. The service worker (sw.js, through the generated media-hosts.js) asks the media host for a clip in one of these folders first and falls back to this site's own copy, so a site that carries every clip (Render) and a slim site that carries none both work. The bytes must be identical on both sides: 'trees' records the folder contents the hosts were last synced to, and tests/media-hosts.test.js fails when a folder changes here without a new sync (node tools/deploy/media-hosts.mjs --sync <alef-packs clone> <alef-audio clone>). Set enabled to false to make every clip come from this site again.
